hints.title: Sequential Accumulator Combination
hints.text: A transformation produces a single value by sequentially combining each item of a sequence with an accumulated total.

hints.title: Loop-Based State Update
hints.text: Initialize a variable with the provided initial value. Iterate through the array sequentially, updating the accumulator to the output of fn(accumulator, current).

hints.title: Reducer Implementation Steps
hints.text: Let val = init. Run a for loop over nums: val = fn(val, nums[i]). When loop finishes, return val.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Single forward pass invoking callback once per element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Array.prototype.reduce cannot be used when the problem strictly prohibits built-in library functions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space maintaining a single running accumulator variable.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct ordering of callback parameters (accum, current) and handling empty array returning init immediately.
